2.original: This symbol indicates the defensive stance <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Iron Will<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is in effect, which increases enmity.
2.translation: Questo simbolo indica che è attiva la postura difensiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volontà Ferrea<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta l'ostilità.

3.original: You can view the job gauge description at any time from the Actions & Traits menu.
3.translation: Puoi consultare in qualsiasi momento la descrizione della Barra Job dal menu Azioni e Tratti.

5.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Oath Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current strength of a paladin's oath, which increases as auto-attacks are performed. A strong oath is required to execute several select actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Sheltron<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cover<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 45), and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Intervention<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 62), and will grow weaker upon using them.<hex:02100103>Using certain actions will increase the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Oath Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
5.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Giuramento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra quanto è saldo il giuramento del paladino, che cresce a ogni attacco automatico. Serve un giuramento saldo per eseguire alcune azioni, come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scudo Protettivo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Copertura<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 45) e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Intercessione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 62); dopo averle usate, il giuramento si indebolisce.<hex:02100103>Alcune azioni aumentano la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Giuramento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

7.original: This symbol indicates the defensive stance <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Defiance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is in effect, which increases enmity.
7.translation: Questo simbolo indica che è attiva la postura difensiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sfida<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta l'ostilità.

9.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Beast Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current strength of a warrior's wrath. This animalistic rage is required to execute several select actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Inner Beast<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Cyclone<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 45) and will grow weaker upon using them.<hex:02100103>Using certain actions will increase the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Beast Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
9.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Bestiale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra quanto è intensa la furia del guerriero. Questa rabbia animalesca serve a eseguire alcune azioni, come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bestia Interiore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ciclone d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 45), e si indebolisce quando vengono usate.<hex:02100103>Alcune azioni aumentano la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Bestiale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

11.original: This symbol indicates the defensive stance <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Grit<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is in effect, which increases enmity.
11.translation: Questo simbolo indica che è attiva la postura difensiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Tenacia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta l'ostilità.

13.original: This timer indicates the duration of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Darkside<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which increases damage dealt. Using <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flood of Darkness<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Edge of Darkness<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 40) grants <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Darkside<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
13.translation: Il timer indica quanto dura <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lato Oscuro<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta i danni inflitti. L'uso di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Marea dell'Oscurità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lama dell'Oscurità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 40) conferisce <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lato Oscuro<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

15.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blood Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the amount of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blackblood<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a dark knight has accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blackblood<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be consumed to execute actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bloodspiller<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Quietus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 64).<hex:02100103>Using certain actions will increase the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blood Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
15.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Sangue<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra la quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sangue Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulata da un cavaliere oscuro. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sangue Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> può essere consumato per eseguire azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Spargisangue<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Quiete<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 64).<hex:02100103>Alcune azioni aumentano la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Sangue<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

17.original: This symbol indicates that the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Dark Arts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect has been granted. This occurs when the barrier applied by the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>The Blackest Night<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> has absorbed the full amount of damage.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flood of Darkness<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Edge of Darkness<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be performed by consuming <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Dark Arts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> instead of MP while the effect is active.
17.translation: Questo simbolo indica che è attivo l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arti Oscure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Si ottiene quando la barriera creata dall'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Notte Più Nera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> esaurisce la propria capacità di assorbimento.<hex:02100103>Quando l'effetto è attivo, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Marea dell'Oscurità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lama dell'Oscurità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> consumando <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arti Oscure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> al posto dei PM.

19.original: When executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Living Shadow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a second timer indicating its duration will appear.
19.translation: Quando esegui <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ombra Vivente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, compare un secondo timer che ne indica la durata.

21.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Healing Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current number of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lilies<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a white mage has accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lilies<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are accumulated as time passes while engaged in combat.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lilies<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are consumed by using the actions <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Afflatus Solace<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Afflatus Rapture<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 76).
21.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra di Guarigione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra quanti <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Gigli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ha accumulato il mago bianco. I <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Gigli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si accumulano col passare del tempo durante il combattimento.<hex:02100103>I <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Gigli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sono consumati dalle azioni <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Conforto di Afflatus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estasi d'Afflatus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 76).

23.original: Performing actions that consume <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lilies<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will also nourish the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blood Lily<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blood Lily<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will bloom after consuming three <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lilies<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, allowing the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Afflatus Misery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
23.translation: Le azioni che consumano <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Gigli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nutrono anche il <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Giglio Sanguigno<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Il <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Giglio Sanguigno<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sboccia dopo aver consumato tre <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Gigli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e permette di eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Miseria di Afflatus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

25.original: Using the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherflow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> fills the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherflow Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which is required to use certain actions.
25.translation: Usare l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flusso Eterico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> riempie la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Eteroflusso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, necessaria per eseguire determinate azioni.

27.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Faerie Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current amount of fae aether accumulated within a faerie. Fae aether is accumulated by using actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lustrate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Excogitation<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in combat, depleting the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherflow Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Maintaining an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherpact<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> consumes fae aether.
27.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Fata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra la quantità di etere fatato accumulata da una fata. Durante il combattimento, l'etere fatato si accumula usando azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Purificazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Escogitazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che consumano la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Eteroflusso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Mantenere attivo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Patto Etereo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> consuma etere fatato.

29.original: Using the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Summon Seraph<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> replaces Eos with Seraph. The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Faerie Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will indicate how much time remains before she must return.
29.translation: Usare l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Evocazione Serafino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sostituisce Eos con Serafino. La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Fata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica quanto tempo resta prima che Serafino debba ritirarsi.

31.original: Using the actions <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Astral Draw<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Umbral Draw<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will replace <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Play I<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Play II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Play III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> with their respective arcanum, which will be represented in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Arcana Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

32.translation: Barre della Divinazione e degli Arcani

33.translation: Usando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pesca Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Arcano Minore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> viene sostituito da <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Signore delle Corone<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; usando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pesca Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, viene sostituito da <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Signora delle Corone<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

35.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Chakra Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indicates the number of chakra a monk currently has opened. Chakra are opened using actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steeled Meditation<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, or by using certain weaponskills. Opening five allows for the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Peak<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Howling Fist<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 40).
35.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dei Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica quanti chakra ha attivato il monaco. Puoi attivarli con azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Meditazione d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o con determinate tecniche. Attivandone cinque, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Picco d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pugno Ululante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 40).

37.original: Executing certain weaponskills will open <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Beast Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>─<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Opo-opo Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coeurl Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raptor Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>─in accordance with the form normally required to execute them. After opening three, you will be able to execute one of several powerful actions. Three distinct <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Beast Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> allow the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flint Strike<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, three of the same allow the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elixir Field<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and two distinct chakra with a third repeating one allow the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Celestial Revolution<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>It is also possible to open the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lunar Nadi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Solar Nadi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elixir Field<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flint Strike<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> respectively. Opening three <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Beast Chakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and both nadi allows the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tornado Kick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
37.translation: Eseguendo determinate tecniche, attivi i <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra Bestiali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del tipo corrispondente alla forma normalmente richiesta per usarle: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra dell'Opo-opo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra del Coeurl<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra del Raptor<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Dopo averne attivati tre, puoi eseguire una delle potenti azioni disponibili. Tre <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra Bestiali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diversi consentono di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Colpo di Selce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; tre uguali, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Campo Elisir<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; due diversi e un terzo uguale a uno dei due, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rivoluzione Celeste<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi anche attivare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Nadi Lunare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Nadi Solare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> eseguendo rispettivamente <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Campo Elisir<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Colpo di Selce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Attivando tre <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Chakra Bestiali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed entrambi i Nadi, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Calcio Tornado<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

39.original: The action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Brotherhood<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> grants the effect <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Meditative Brotherhood<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to you and nearby party members, increasing the frequency with which you open chakra. Moreover, you can open up to ten chakra so long as you are under this effect.
39.translation: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fratellanza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce a te e ai membri del gruppo vicini l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fratellanza Meditativa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, aumentando la frequenza con cui attivi i chakra. Finché l'effetto è attivo, puoi attivare fino a dieci chakra.

41.original: This timer indicates the duration of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blood of the Dragon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which increases damage dealt. Using <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Geirskogul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> grants <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Blood of the Dragon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
41.translation: Questo timer indica la durata di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sangue del Drago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta i danni inflitti. Usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Geirskogul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sangue del Drago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

43.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lance Mastery IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, the actions <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Raiden Thrust<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Draconian Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be executed to sharpen the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Firstminds' Focus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, up to a maximum of 2 units. Once their focus is fully sharpened, you can execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wyrmwind Thrust<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
43.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Maestria della Lancia IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Affondo di Raiden<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Furia Draconica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per affinare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Concentrazione delle Prime Menti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, fino a un massimo di 2 cariche. Quando la concentrazione è al massimo, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Affondo del Vento Draconico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

46.original: Using the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Armor Crush<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> as part of a combo grants stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kazematoi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, represented by this gauge. Up to five stacks can be stored, and are used to increase the potency of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aeolian Edge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
46.translation: Usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Frantuma Armatura<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in una combo conferisce cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kazematoi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, indicate da questa barra. Puoi accumularne fino a cinque, da usare per aumentare la potenza di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lama Eolica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

48.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ninki Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current amount of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ninki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a ninja has accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ninki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> slowly builds inside a ninja's body when certain weaponskills are performed and can be used to execute special ninjutsu such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hellfrog Medium<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bhavacakra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 68).
48.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Ninki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra la quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ninki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulata dal ninja. Il <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ninki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> cresce lentamente nel corpo del ninja quando esegue determinate tecniche e può essere usato per eseguire ninjutsu speciali come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rana Infernale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ruota dell'Esistenza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 68).

50.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Sen Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays which of the 3 <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effects─<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Setsu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (top), <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Getsu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (left), and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ka<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (right)─are currently accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is required to perform <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Iaijutsu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, the number of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulated determining which weaponskill will be executed─1 for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Higanbana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, 2 for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tenka Goken<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and 3 for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Midare Setsugekka<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

52.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Kenki Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current amount of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a samurai has accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> slowly builds in a samurai's blade through the successful execution of weaponskills or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Third Eye<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is required to execute special devastating attacks such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Shinten<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Gyoten<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 54), <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Guren<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 70), and more.
52.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra la quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulata dal samurai. Il <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si accumula lentamente nella lama del samurai quando vanno a segno le tecniche o quando usa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Terzo Occhio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Serve <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Kenki<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire attacchi speciali devastanti come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Shinten<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Gyoten<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccato al livello 54), <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hissatsu: Guren<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccato al livello 70) e altri ancora.

54.original: Singing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mage's Ballad<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will display the action's corresponding <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Song Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, indicating the effect's time remaining.<hex:02100103>If the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertoire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect is triggered while <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mage's Ballad<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is being sung, the recast times for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bloodletter<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rain of Death<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (learned at level 45) are reduced.
54.translation: Quando canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ballata del Mago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, viene mostrata la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Canzoni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> corrispondente, che indica il tempo rimanente dell'effetto.<hex:02100103>Se <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si attiva mentre canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ballata del Mago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, il tempo di ricarica di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Dardo Sanguinario<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pioggia Mortale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (appresa al livello 45) si riduce.

55.original: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>“詩心”<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>は<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>「ベノムバイト/コースティックバイト」<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>、<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>「ウィンドバイト/ストームバイト」<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>による継続ダメージの命中時に一定確率で発動します。戦歌を使い、詩心を付与させていくことで吟遊詩人の攻撃力を高めることができます。
55.translation: Il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si attiva con una certa probabilità quando vanno a segno i danni periodici di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Morso Velenoso/Morso Caustico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Morso Ventoso/Morso della Tempesta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Usando i canti di guerra e attivando l'effetto Repertorio, puoi aumentare la potenza d'attacco del bardo.

56.original: Singing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Army's Paeon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will display the action's corresponding <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Song Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, indicating the effect's time remaining.<hex:02100103>If the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertoire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect is triggered while <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Army's Paeon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is being sung, the bard is granted reduced weaponskill cast time and recast time, spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay according to the number of stacks accumulated.
56.translation: Quando canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Peana dell'Esercito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, viene mostrata la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Canzoni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> corrispondente, che indica il tempo rimanente dell'effetto.<hex:02100103>Se <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si attiva mentre canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Peana dell'Esercito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, in base alle cariche accumulate si riducono i tempi di esecuzione e ricarica delle tecniche e degli incantesimi, nonché l'intervallo tra gli attacchi automatici del bardo.

57.original: Singing the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wanderer's Minuet<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will display the action's corresponding <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Song Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, indicating the effect's time remaining.<hex:02100103>If the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertoire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> effect is triggered while the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wanderer's Minuet<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is being sung, the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pitch Perfect<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will become available. The potency of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pitch Perfect<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases according to the number of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertoire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> stacks.
57.translation: Quando canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Minuetto del Viandante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, viene mostrata la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Canzoni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> corrispondente, che indica il tempo rimanente dell'effetto.<hex:02100103>Se <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si attiva mentre canti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Minuetto del Viandante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Intonazione Perfetta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La potenza di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Intonazione Perfetta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta in base al numero di cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

59.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Soul Voice Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases in tandem with <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertoire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and is depleted when using the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Apex Arrow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
59.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Voce dell'Anima<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta insieme a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Repertorio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e si svuota quando usi l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Freccia Suprema<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

61.original: Performing certain weaponskills will increase the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Heat Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and once it is high enough, the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hypercharge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will become available. Using <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hypercharge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> overheats your weapon and allows the use of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Heat Blast<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 35) and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Auto Crossbow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 52).
61.translation: L'uso di determinate tecniche aumenta la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Termica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando è abbastanza carica, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ipercarica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ipercarica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> surriscalda l'arma e ti permette di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Esplosione Rovente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 35) e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Balestra Automatica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 52).

63.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Battery Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulates when certain actions are performed and allows the placement of a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rook Autoturret<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will attack your target. It also allows the deployment of an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Automaton Queen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 80) to fight alongside you.
63.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Batteria<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si carica eseguendo determinate azioni e permette di schierare una <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Torretta Automatica Rook<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che attacca il bersaglio. Consente anche di schierare una <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Regina Automa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 80) che combatte al tuo fianco.

65.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elemental Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indicates whether you are under the influence of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (after casting a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spell) or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (after casting a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blizzard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spell). While under the influence of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, all <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spells will have increased potency, but require more MP to cast. While under the influence of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, all <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blizzard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spells will have no cost, and will recover MP upon striking a target. Furthermore, when maintaining stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a spell of the opposite element can be cast at no cost but will deal reduced damage.
65.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Elementale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica se sei sotto l'effetto di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (dopo aver lanciato un incantesimo di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fuoco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>) o di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (dopo aver lanciato un incantesimo di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gelo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>). Sotto l'effetto di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, gli incantesimi di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fuoco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> infliggono più danni, ma consumano più PM. Sotto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, gli incantesimi di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gelo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> non consumano PM e ripristinano PM quando colpiscono un bersaglio. Inoltre, mantenendo le cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi lanciare senza costo un incantesimo dell'elemento opposto, che però infligge meno danni.

66.original: Coming under the influence of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will grant <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and set the lower-right corner of the gauge aglow, indicating its effect is active. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases the potency of magic attacks, as well as unlocks powerful spells such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blizzard IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> fades when <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> expires.
66.translation: L'effetto di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e illumina l'angolo in basso a destra della barra. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta la potenza degli attacchi magici e sblocca incantesimi potenti come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gelo IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> svanisce quando terminano <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

67.original: Casting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Freeze<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blizzard IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> grants 3 <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Hearts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> which are represented by the arrows in the gauge's lower-left corner. An <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Heart<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is consumed each time a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> spell is cast, nullifying the MP cost increase applied by the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status.
67.translation: Lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Congelamento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gelo IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce tre <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuori Umbrali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, rappresentati dalle frecce nell'angolo in basso a sinistra della barra. Ogni <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuore Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> viene consumato quando lanci un incantesimo di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fuoco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e annulla l'aumento del costo in PM dovuto all'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

68.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> bar will fill every 30 seconds the status is maintained. When the crystal at the bottom of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elemental Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> glows pink, you will be under effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Polyglot<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which allows the spells <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Foul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 80) to be cast, consuming a crystal.
68.translation: La barra dell'<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si riempie ogni 30 secondi in cui mantieni l'effetto. Quando il cristallo in fondo alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Elementale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si illumina di rosa, ottieni l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Poliglotta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che permette di lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Obbrobrio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 80) consumando un cristallo.

69.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> bar will fill every 30 seconds the status is maintained. When one or more crystals at the bottom of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elemental Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> glow pink, you will be under effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Polyglot<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which allows the spells <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Foul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 80) to be cast, consuming a crystal.
69.translation: La barra dell'<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si riempie ogni 30 secondi in cui mantieni l'effetto. Quando uno o più cristalli in fondo alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Elementale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si illuminano di rosa, ottieni l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Poliglotta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che permette di lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Obbrobrio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 80) consumando un cristallo.

71.original: Using the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Energy Drain<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> fills the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherflow Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which is required to perform certain actions.
71.translation: Usare l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assorbimento d'Energia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> riempie la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Eteroflusso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, necessaria per eseguire determinate azioni.

73.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indicates the time remaining for the effects of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aethercharge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Executing this action also grants <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ruby Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Topaz Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Emerald Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which are used to summon <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ifrit-Egi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Topaz Carbuncle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Emerald Carbuncle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> respectively.
73.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica quanto resta agli effetti di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Carica Eterea<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Usando questa azione, ottieni <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Rubino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Topazio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Smeraldo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che servono rispettivamente a evocare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ifrit-Egi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Carbuncle di Topazio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Carbuncle di Smeraldo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

74.original: Each summon, when called forth, will tap into its respective <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, granting you stacks of an elemental attunement, indicated on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. These elemental attunements will augment <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemshine<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Precious Brilliance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 26).
74.translation: Ogni creatura evocata attinge al proprio <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e ti conferisce cariche di affinità elementale, indicate sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Queste affinità potenziano <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemma Splendente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bagliore Prezioso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 26).

75.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Aethercharge Mastery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will indicate the remaining time for the effects of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Dreadwyrm Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. While under its effects, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ruin III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is upgraded to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Astral Impulse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Outburst<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is upgraded to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Astral Flare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Dreadwyrm Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> also grants <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ruby Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Topaz Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Emerald Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
75.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Maestria in Carica Eterea<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica quanto resta agli effetti di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance del Wyrm del Terrore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Durante l'effetto, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rovina III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impulso Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Esplosione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fusione Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance del Wyrm del Terrore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce anche <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Rubino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Topazio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Smeraldo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

76.original: Each summon, when called forth, will tap into its respective <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, granting you stacks of an elemental attunement, indicated on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. These elemental attunements will augment <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemshine<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Precious Brilliance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
76.translation: Ogni creatura evocata attinge al proprio <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e ti conferisce cariche di affinità elementale, indicate sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Queste affinità potenziano <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemma Splendente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bagliore Prezioso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

79.original: Performing a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Standard Step<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> changes the appearance of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Step Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and causes you to start dancing. Following the displayed icons to execute steps in the correct order and ending with <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Standard Finish<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase your damage dealt and that of the party member designated as your <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Dance Partner<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The remaining duration of these effects is displayed beneath the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Step Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
79.translation: Eseguendo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Passo Standard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, l'aspetto della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dei Passi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> cambia e inizi a danzare. Segui le icone mostrate ed esegui i passi nell'ordine corretto, poi concludi con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Finale Standard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>: aumenteranno i danni che infliggi tu e il membro del gruppo designato come <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Compagno di Danza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La durata residua di questi effetti è indicata sotto la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dei Passi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

81.original: Actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reverse Cascade<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rising Windmill<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> have a chance to grant <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fourfold Feathers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which are consumed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fan Dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fan Dance II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 50).
81.translation: Azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cascata Inversa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mulinello Ascendente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> possono conferire <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Piume Quadrigemine<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, consumabili con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Danza del Ventaglio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Danza del Ventaglio II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 50).

83.original: Performing a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Technical Step<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will display four icons on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Step Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Executing the corresponding actions in the correct order followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Technical Finish<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases the damage dealt by you and nearby party members.
83.translation: Eseguendo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Passo Tecnico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dei Passi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> compaiono quattro icone. Esegui le azioni corrispondenti nell'ordine corretto e poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Finale Tecnico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per aumentare i danni che infliggi tu e i membri del gruppo nelle vicinanze.

84.translation: Piume Quadrigemine e Indicatore dello Spirito

85.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Esprit Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulates when you or party members under the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Esprit<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>─granted by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Standard Finish<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Technical Finish<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>─execute weaponskills or cast spells. It is consumed by the action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Saber Dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
85.translation: L'<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Indicatore dello Spirito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si carica quando tu o i membri del gruppo sotto l'effetto di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Spirito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, conferito da <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Finale Standard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Finale Tecnico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, eseguite tecniche o lanciate incantesimi. Si consuma con l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Danza della Sciabola<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

87.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Balance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> displays the current amount of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Black Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a red mage has accumulated. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Black Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is accumulated by casting spells commonly associated with black magic (such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Thunder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>), and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by casting spells associated with white magic (such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>). There are also some spells and actions that affect both.
87.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Equilibrio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra la quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Bianco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulata dal mago rosso. La quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta lanciando incantesimi tipici della magia nera, come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fuoco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tuono<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; quella di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Bianco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> cresce lanciando quelli tipici della magia bianca, come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Alcuni incantesimi e azioni influiscono su entrambi.

88.original: When both <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Black Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> reach a certain amount, weaponskills such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Riposte<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> become enchanted and will deal additional damage. If the gap between <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Black Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulation grows too large, the crystal at the top of the gauge will change color, and it will become more difficult to accumulate the lesser of the two.
88.translation: Quando gli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Bianco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> raggiungono una certa soglia, tecniche come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risposta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si caricano d'incanto e infliggono danni aggiuntivi. Se la differenza tra l'accumulo di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Nero<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e quello di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Bianco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa troppo ampia, il cristallo in cima alla barra cambia colore e diventa più difficile accumulare il mana presente in quantità minore.

90.original: This symbol indicates the defensive stance <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Royal Guard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is in effect, which increases enmity.
90.translation: Questo simbolo indica che la postura difensiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Guardia Reale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> è attiva e aumenta l'ostilità.

92.original: Performing a combo ending in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Solid Barrel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demon Slaughter<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 40) adds cartridges to the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Powder Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which are expended by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Burst Strike<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gnashing Fang<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 60).
92.translation: Eseguendo una combo che termina con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Canna Solida<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Massacro Demoniaco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 40), aggiungi cartucce alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Cartucce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che puoi consumare con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Colpo Esplosivo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanna Rabbiosa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 60).
