108.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Minstrel's Coda<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, singing the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mage's Ballad<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Army's Paeon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, or the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wanderer's Minuet<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will grant a corresponding <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coda<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. With at least one <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coda<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> active, you can execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Radiant Finale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
108.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coda del Menestrello<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, cantare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ballata del Mago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Peana dell'Esercito<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Minuetto del Viandante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coda<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> corrispondente. Con almeno una <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coda<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> attiva, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Finale Radioso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

109.original: While under the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or when possessing maximum stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Ice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Umbral Hearts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, swapping to the opposite element will allow you to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Paradox<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
109.translation: Quando è attivo <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o hai il massimo degli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ghiaccio Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuori Umbrali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, passare all'elemento opposto ti permette di eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Paradosso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

110.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartridge Charge II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a third <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartridge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be stored in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Powder Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartridges<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are added to the gauge by using combo actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Solid Barrel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demon Slaughter<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 40). <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartridges<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can then be used to execute several actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Burst Strike<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gnashing Fang<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 60).
110.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Caricamento Cartucce II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi conservare una terza <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartuccia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nella <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Cartucce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Le <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartucce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si aggiungono alla barra eseguendo combo con azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Canna Solida<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Massacro Demoniaco<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 40). Puoi poi usare le <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartucce<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Colpo Esplosivo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanna Rabbiosa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 60).

111.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Soul Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be filled via the execution of certain weaponskills, or by defeating enemies afflicted with <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Death's Design<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. With sufficient souls stored in the gauge, you can execute actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Blood Stalk<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Grim Swathe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 55), or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gluttony<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 76).
111.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Anima<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si riempie eseguendo determinate tecniche o sconfiggendo nemici afflitti da <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Marchio della Morte<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando hai accumulato abbastanza anime nella barra, puoi eseguire azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Caccia Sanguinaria<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Falciata Sinistra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 55) o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gola Vorace<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 76).

112.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Shroud Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> signifies the strength of your bond with your avatar. When the gauge is sufficiently filled, you can execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enshroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to temporarily serve as host to your avatar.
112.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Sudario<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica la forza del legame con il tuo avatar. Quando è abbastanza carica, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ammantare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per ospitare temporaneamente il tuo avatar.

113.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Shroud Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be filled via the execution of certain weaponskills. With sufficient energy stored in the gauge, you can execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enshroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
113.translation: Puoi caricare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra del Sudario<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> eseguendo determinate tecniche. Quando hai accumulato abbastanza energia nella barra, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ammantare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

114.original: Stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lemure Shroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be consumed to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Void Reaping<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Communio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 90).
114.translation: Puoi consumare gli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sudario di Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mietitura del Vuoto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Comunione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 90).

120.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Addersgall Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indicates accumulated stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersgall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which are restored automatically over time. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersgall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be consumed to execute actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Druochole<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Kerachole<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 50).
120.translation: La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra dell'Addersgall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica quante cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersgall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> hai; la quantità di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersgall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si ripristina automaticamente col passare del tempo. Puoi consumarle per eseguire azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Druocura<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Kerachole<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 50).

121.original: The gauge builds stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersting<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> when the barrier effect of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Eukrasian Diagnosis<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Eukrasian Prognosis<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is completely absorbed. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Addersting<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> stacks can be used to execute actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Toxikon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Toxikon II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
121.translation: La barra accumula <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Pungiglione della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> quando la barriera di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Diagnosi Eukrasica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Prognosi Eukrasica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> esaurisce la propria capacità di assorbimento. Puoi consumare gli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Pungiglione della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tossico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tossico II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

122.original: バランスゲージ/マナスタックシンボル
122.translation: Barra dell'Equilibrio e simbolo delle cariche di mana

123.original: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mana Stacks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are gained by executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enchanted Riposte<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enchanted Zwerchhau<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enchanted Redoublement<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enchanted Moulinet<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and are consumed by casting spells. At maximum stacks, you can cast <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Verflare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Verholy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 70).
123.translation: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Accumuli di Mana<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si ottengono eseguendo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risposta Incantata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zwerchhau Incantato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Raddoppio Incantato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Molinello Incantato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e si consumano lanciando incantesimi. Al massimo degli accumuli, puoi lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Verfusione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Versancta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 70).

124.original: Once <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enshrouded<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Death Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will display the time remaining to play host to your avatar, as well as your stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lemure Shroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which are consumed to use powerful attacks such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Void Reaping<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Communio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 90).
124.translation: Quando sei sotto l'effetto di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ammantato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Morte<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mostra il tempo rimanente in cui ospiterai il tuo avatar e gli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sudario di Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che puoi consumare per usare attacchi potenti come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mietitura del Vuoto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Comunione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 90).

125.original: The actions <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Twin Snakes<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demolish<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 30), and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Dragon Kick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 50) will grant stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Opo-opo Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raptor Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Coeurl Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The fury granted is commensurate with the form required for their execution. Other weaponskills that require these forms will consume stacks of fury to deal increased damage.
125.translation: Le azioni <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Doppio Serpente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demolizione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 30) e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Calcio del Drago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 50) conferiscono accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Furia dell'Opo-opo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Furia del Raptor<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Furia del Coeurl<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, in base alla forma richiesta per eseguirle. Le altre tecniche che richiedono queste forme consumano gli accumuli di furia per infliggere più danni.

126.original: This timer indicates the duration of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Life of the Dragon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which increases damage dealt. Using <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Geirskogul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> grants <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Life of the Dragon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and allows for the execution of more powerful actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Nastrond<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Stardiver<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 80).
126.translation: Questo timer indica la durata di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Vita del Drago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta i danni inflitti. Usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Geirskogul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Vita del Drago<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e permette di eseguire azioni più potenti, come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Riva dei Cadaveri<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tuffo Stellare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 80).

127.original: Using <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Raiden Thrust<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Draconian Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will sharpen the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Firstminds' Focus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, up to a maximum of 2 units. Once their focus is fully sharpened, you can execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wyrmwind Thrust<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
127.translation: Usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Affondo di Raiden<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Furia Draconica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affina <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Concentrazione delle Prime Menti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, fino a un massimo di due cariche. Quando la concentrazione è al massimo, puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Affondo del Vento Draconico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

128.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> bar will fill every 30 seconds the status is maintained. When one or more crystals at the bottom of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Elemental Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> glow pink, you will be under effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Polyglot<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which allows the spells <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Foul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 80) to be cast, consuming a crystal.
128.translation: La barra di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Enochian<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si riempie ogni 30 secondi in cui mantieni l'effetto. Quando uno o più cristalli in fondo alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra Elementale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si illuminano di rosa, ottieni l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Poliglotta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che permette di lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Obbrobrio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Xenoglossia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 80) consumando un cristallo.

129.original: While under the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Fire<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, casting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fire IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will grant stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Astral Soul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. At maximum stacks, you can cast <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flare Star<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
129.translation: Con <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Fuoco Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> attivo, lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fuoco IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fusione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Anima Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Al massimo degli accumuli, puoi lanciare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Stella della Fusione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

131.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enhanced Summon Bahamut II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, it is possible to summon <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Solar Bahamut<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to fight at your side.<hex:02100103>Summoning <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Solar Bahamut<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> also grants you <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ruby Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Topaz Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Emerald Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will indicate <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Solar Bahamut<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>'s time remaining on the battlefield, during which <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ruin III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be upgraded to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Umbral Impulse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tri-disaster<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Umbral Flare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Astral Flow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Sunflare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
131.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Evoca Bahamut Potenziato II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi evocare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Bahamut Solare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> perché combatta al tuo fianco.<hex:02100103>L'evocazione di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Bahamut Solare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce anche <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Rubino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Topazio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano di Smeraldo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> indica per quanto tempo <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Bahamut Solare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> resta in campo; durante questo periodo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rovina III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impulso Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Triplice Disastro<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fusione Umbrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flusso Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fusione Solare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

132.original: Each summon, when called forth, will tap into its respective <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcanum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, granting you stacks of an elemental attunement, indicated on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trance Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. These elemental attunements will augment <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemshine<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Precious Brilliance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Elemental Mastery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 86), <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Astral Flow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will also be enhanced by elemental attunement.
132.translation: Ogni creatura evocata attinge al proprio <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Arcano<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e ti conferisce cariche di affinità elementale, indicate sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Trance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Queste affinità potenziano <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gemma Splendente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bagliore Prezioso<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Maestria Elementale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccato al livello 86), anche <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Flusso Astrale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> viene potenziato dall'affinità elementale.

135.original: Viper engages enemies mainly through the use of three-step combos, their primary combos beginning with either <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Fangs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reaving Fangs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The third step can end with one of several weaponskills, each of which grants an effect to strengthen a different combo-ending action. To reach these actions will require the use of specific combo routes.<hex:02100103>The glow of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vipersight<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>'s blades correspond with the outlining of hotbar icons to indicate the next step in a combo.<hex:02100103>For example, when <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Fangs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is highlighted, the left blade of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vipersight<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will glow. When <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reaving Fangs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is highlighted, the right blade of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vipersight<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will glow. Moreover, the color of the gauge will indicate the step of the combo you've reached.<hex:02100103>Following these indicators will help ensure the use of combos that finish with a strengthened attack.
135.translation: La Vipera affronta i nemici soprattutto con combo di tre tecniche, le cui sequenze principali iniziano con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanne d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanne Predatrici<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La terza tecnica può concludersi con una fra diverse tecniche, ciascuna delle quali conferisce un effetto che potenzia una diversa azione finale della combo. Per raggiungere queste azioni è necessario seguire percorsi di combo specifici.<hex:02100103>Il bagliore delle lame della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vista della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> corrisponde al contorno delle icone sulla barra delle azioni e indica il passaggio successivo della combo.<hex:02100103>Per esempio, quando è evidenziata l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanne d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, brilla la lama sinistra della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vista della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; quando è evidenziata l'azione <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Zanne Predatrici<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, brilla la lama destra della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vista della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Inoltre, il colore della barra indica quale passaggio della combo hai raggiunto.<hex:02100103>Seguire questi indicatori aiuta a concludere la combo con un attacco potenziato.

136.original: The use of certain weaponskills will grant a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rattling Coil<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, indicated by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vipersight<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rattling Coils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be spent to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Uncoiled Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
136.translation: Alcune tecniche conferiscono una <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Spirale Tintinnante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, fino a un massimo di due accumuli, indicati dalla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vista della Vipera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Puoi consumare le <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Spirali Tintinnanti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Furia Liberata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

137.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enhanced Viper's Rattle<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a third <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rattling Coil<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be stored. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rattling Coils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are accumulated through the use of certain actions, and can be spent to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Uncoiled Fury<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
137.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sonaglio della Vipera Potenziato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi conservare una terza <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Spirale Tintinnante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Le <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Spirali Tintinnanti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si accumulano eseguendo determinate azioni e possono essere consumate per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Furia Liberata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

138.original: The use of certain weaponskills in the execution of combos will serve to fill the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Serpent Offerings Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Once sufficient energy has been stored, you can activate <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reawaken<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will open the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Anguine Tributes<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on the gauge. These tributes can be used to execute several special weaponskills unique to your reawakened state.
138.translation: Alcune tecniche eseguite durante le combo caricano la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra delle Offerte Serpentine<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando hai accumulato abbastanza energia, puoi attivare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risveglio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che rende disponibili i <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Tributi Serpentini<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sulla barra. Puoi consumare questi tributi per eseguire diverse tecniche speciali, disponibili solo nello stato risvegliato.

139.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enhanced Serpent's Lineage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a fifth <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Anguine Tribute<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be added to the gauge. Once sufficient energy has been stored, you can activate <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reawaken<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will open the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Anguine Tributes<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on the gauge. These tributes can be used to execute several special weaponskills unique to your reawakened state.
139.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lignaggio della Serpe Potenziato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, viene aggiunto alla barra un quinto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Tributo Serpentino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando hai accumulato abbastanza energia, puoi attivare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risveglio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che rende disponibili i <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Tributi Serpentini<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sulla barra. Puoi consumare questi tributi per eseguire diverse tecniche speciali, disponibili solo nello stato risvegliato.

142.original: Pictomancer eschews the stave for a brush, painting their imaginings upon a canvas and bringing them to life through magic.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Creature Motifs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are painted on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Creature Canvas<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and can be rendered to life through <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Living Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, simultaneously granting a depiction of the rendered motif. Assembling <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Pom<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Wings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> creates a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moogle Portrait<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, allowing the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mog of the Ages<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
142.translation: Il Pittomante dipinge ciò che immagina su una tela e lo anima con la magia, usando un pennello al posto del bastone.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi delle Creature<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Creature<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Vivente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che crea anche una Raffigurazione del motivo. Unendo la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione di Pom<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione delle Ali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ottieni un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ritratto di Moguri<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che ti permette di eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mog dei Tempi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

143.original: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Weapon Motifs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are painted on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Weapon Canvas<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and can be rendered to life through <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>hammer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is painted on the canvas, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Striking Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be performed, allowing the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hammer Stamp<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
143.translation: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi delle Armi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Armi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando sulla tela è dipinto un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>martello<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Battagliera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timbro Martello<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

144.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Palette Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be accumulated by executing certain aetherhue spells. Once your palette is sufficiently saturated with aether, you can consume a portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Palette Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Subtractive Palette<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will temporarily alter the properties of your aetherhue spells, significantly enhancing them.
144.translation: Puoi caricare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Tavolozza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> lanciando determinati incantesimi legati alle Tinte Eteree. Quando la tavolozza è sufficientemente satura di etere, puoi consumare una parte della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Tavolozza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tavolozza Sottrattiva<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che modifica temporaneamente le proprietà degli incantesimi legati alle Tinte Eteree e li potenzia notevolmente.

145.original: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Landscape Motifs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are painted on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Landscape Canvas<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and can be rendered to life through <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scenic Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>starry sky<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is painted on the canvas, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Starry Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be performed, increasing the damage dealt by self and party members.
145.translation: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi del Paesaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela del Paesaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Paesaggista<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando dipingi un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>cielo stellato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Stellata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta i danni inflitti da te e dai membri del gruppo.

146.original: Pictomancer eschews the stave for a brush, painting their imaginings upon a canvas and bringing them to life through magic. Utilizzando la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Creature<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Armi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela del Paesaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, può produrre diversi effetti.

147.translation: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi delle Creature<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Creature<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Vivente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che crea anche una Raffigurazione del motivo. Unendo la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione di Pom<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione delle Ali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ottieni un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ritratto di Moguri<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che ti permette di eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mog dei Tempi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

148.original: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Weapon Motifs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are painted on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Weapon Canvas<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and can be rendered to life through <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Steel Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>hammer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is painted on the canvas, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Striking Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be performed, allowing the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hammer Stamp<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Landscape Motifs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are painted on the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Landscape Canvas<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and can be rendered to life through <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scenic Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>starry sky<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is painted on the canvas, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Starry Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be performed, increasing the damage dealt by self and party members.
148.translation: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi delle Armi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela delle Armi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa d'Acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando sulla tela è dipinto un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>martello<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Battagliera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timbro Martello<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivi del Paesaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> vengono dipinti sulla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tela del Paesaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e prendono vita con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Paesaggista<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando dipingi un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>cielo stellato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Stellata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta i danni inflitti da te e dai membri del gruppo.

149.original: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Palette Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Paint<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be accumulated by executing certain aetherhue spells. Once your palette is sufficiently saturated with aether, you can consume a portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Palette Gauge<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Subtractive Palette<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will temporarily alter the properties of your aetherhue spells, significantly enhancing them. Additionally, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Paint<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be spent to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Holy in White<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
149.translation: Puoi caricare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Tavolozza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e ottenere <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Pittura Bianca<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> lanciando determinati incantesimi legati alle Tinte Eteree. Quando la tavolozza è sufficientemente satura di etere, puoi consumare una parte della <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Barra della Tavolozza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tavolozza Sottrattiva<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che modifica temporaneamente le proprietà degli incantesimi legati alle Tinte Eteree e li potenzia notevolmente. Puoi inoltre consumare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Pittura Bianca<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Sancta Bianca<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

150.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Enhanced Palette<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, a splash of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>White Paint<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, when accumulated, will be converted to <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Black Paint<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> upon the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Subtractive Palette<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which can be spent to perform <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Comet in Black<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
150.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Tavolozza Potenziata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, una carica di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Pittura Bianca<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> diventa <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Vernice Nera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> quando esegui <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tavolozza Sottrattiva<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; puoi consumare quest'ultima per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cometa Nera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

151.original: Executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Creature Motif<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Living Muse<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in succession to assemble <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Pom<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Wings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Claw<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Depiction of Fangs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> creates a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Madeen Portrait<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, allowing the execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Retribution of the Madeen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
151.translation: Eseguendo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Motivo Creatura<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Musa Vivente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in successione, puoi ottenere la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione di Pom<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione delle Ali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione dell'Artiglio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e la <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Raffigurazione delle Zanne<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Unendole, crei un <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Ritratto di Madeen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e puoi eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Retribuzione di Madeen<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

152.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Void Soul<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, weaponskills which cost <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lemure Shroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will grant <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Void Shroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> when executed. With sufficient stacks, you can execute actions such as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lemure's Slice<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lemure's Scythe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
152.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Anima del Vuoto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, le tecniche che consumano <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sudario di Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferiscono <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sudario Vuoto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> quando vengono eseguite. Con accumuli sufficienti, puoi usare azioni come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fendente del Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Falce del Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

153.original: Stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Lemure Shroud<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be consumed to execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Void Reaping<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Communio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 90).
153.translation: Puoi consumare gli accumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sudario di Lemure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mietitura del Vuoto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Comunione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccata al livello 90).

157.original: Execution of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bloodfest<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will grant an affect that increases the maximum number of cartridges to 4. Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cartridge Charge II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (acquired at level 88), <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bloodfest<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase the maximum number of cartridges to 6.
157.translation: Eseguire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Festa del Sangue<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> conferisce un effetto che aumenta il numero massimo di cartucce fino a 4. Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Caricamento Cartucce II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (sbloccato al livello 88), <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Festa del Sangue<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta il massimo a 6 cartucce.

160.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Wild Heart<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, you may now accumulate TP by completing combos. After accumulating at least 100 TP, you may expend it all to perform weaponskills with power proportionate to the amount of TP used. Weaponskills that require TP to execute are known as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>instinctual skills<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
160.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuore Selvaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi accumulare TP completando le combo. Una volta accumulati almeno 100 TP, puoi spenderli tutti per eseguire tecniche la cui potenza dipende dalla quantità di TP usata. Queste tecniche sono chiamate <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>azioni istintive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

161.original: The Inner Compass reflects cooperation between you and your familiars. Four instinctual affinities exist for both beastmaster and familiar weaponskills: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When an instinctual skill with one such affinity is executed, its corresponding symbol will light up. If either the beastmaster or familiar executes another instinctual skill within seven seconds of the previous one, an <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>instinctual combo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be completed, dealing extra damage.
161.translation: La Bussola Interiore rappresenta la collaborazione tra te e i tuoi famigli. Esistono quattro affinità istintive sia per le tecniche del domatore sia per quelle del famiglio: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Furente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Resistente<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> ed <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Inquietante<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando esegui un'azione istintiva con una di queste affinità, si illumina il simbolo corrispondente. Se tu o il famiglio eseguite un'altra azione istintiva entro sette secondi dalla precedente, completate una <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>combo istintiva<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> che infligge danni aggiuntivi.

162.original: Furthermore, if the second instinctual skill performed runs clockwise on the Inner Compass, an <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>intentional combo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be completed. Examples of intentional combo affinities are as follows:<hex:02100103>　・Volant → Rampant<hex:02100103>　・Rampant → Durant<hex:02100103>　・Durant → Eldritch<hex:02100103>　・Eldritch → Volant<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Intentional combos<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> are additionally categorized by two instinctual affinities: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Upon completion of these combos, the corresponding side of the Inner Compass will light up. Illuminating the entire Compass may trigger an incredibly powerful attack, so keep honing your skills as a beastmaster until you can accomplish such a feat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Note that the number of chained instinctual skills is recorded beneath the compass. A higher number increases the potency of extra damage dealt by combos.
162.translation: Inoltre, se la seconda azione istintiva eseguita ruota in senso orario sulla Bussola Interiore, completi una <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>combo intenzionale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Ecco alcuni esempi di affinità per una combo intenzionale:<hex:02100103>　・Volante → Furente<hex:02100103>　・Furente → Resistente<hex:02100103>　・Resistente → Inquietante<hex:02100103>　・Inquietante → Volante.<hex:02100103>Le <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>combo intenzionali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sono inoltre suddivise in base a due affinità istintive: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Camminatore del Sole<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cacciatore Lunare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Completando una di queste combo, si illumina il lato corrispondente della Bussola Interiore. Illuminare tutta la bussola può innescare un attacco potentissimo: continua ad allenarti come domatore per riuscirci.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il numero di azioni istintive concatenate è indicato sotto la bussola; più è alto, maggiore è la potenza dei danni aggiuntivi inflitti dalle combo.

163.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Wild Heart II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, your familiar may now accumulate TP via its auto-attacks or by executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Parting Blow<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. After accumulating at least 100 TP, you may order your familiar to perform its <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, thereby expending TP to execute an instinctual skill.
163.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuore Selvaggio II<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, il tuo famiglio può accumulare TP con gli attacchi automatici o usando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Colpo d'Addio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Quando ne ha accumulati almeno 100, puoi ordinargli di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scherzo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e spendere TP per eseguire un'azione istintiva.

164.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Wild Heart III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, you may now accumulate stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by completing combos with beastmaster instinctual skills. All accumulated stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be spent upon executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which instantly increases your TP Gauge proportionate to the number of stacks spent.
164.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuore Selvaggio III<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, puoi accumulare cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Istinto Padroneggiato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> completando combo con le azioni istintive del domatore. Tutte le cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Istinto Padroneggiato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulate vengono consumate usando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Raduna<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta subito la tua Barra TP in base al numero di cariche spese.

165.original: Upon learning the trait <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Wild Heart IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, your familiar may now accumulate stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Natural Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by completing combos with familiar instinctual skills. All accumulated stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Natural Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will be spent upon executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rallying Cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which instantly increases the Familiar TP Gauge proportionate to the number of stacks spent.
165.translation: Dopo aver appreso il tratto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Cuore Selvaggio IV<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, il tuo famiglio può accumulare cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Istinto Naturale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> completando combo con le sue azioni istintive. Tutte le cariche di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Istinto Naturale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> accumulate vengono consumate usando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incitamento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che aumenta subito la Barra TP del famiglio in base al numero di cariche spese.
